events.name: ItemClicked
events.description: The user clicks an item of the menu bar.
events.useCase: Handle all menu commands in one place.

events.name: MenuActivate
events.description: The user starts using the menu with the mouse or the Alt key.
events.useCase: Pause a game or update the enabled state of commands.

events.name: MenuDeactivate
events.description: The user finishes using the menu.

events.name: Opening
events.description: The menu is about to open. Setting Cancel prevents it.
events.useCase: Decide which commands to show for the control that was clicked.

events.name: Opened
events.useCase: Log or update state after the menu is visible.

events.name: Closing
events.description: The menu is about to close. Setting Cancel keeps it open.
events.useCase: Keep the menu open after certain clicks.

events.name: ItemClicked
events.useCase: Handle all items of the menu in one method.

events.name: ItemClicked
events.description: The user clicks any item on the strip.
events.useCase: Handle all toolbar buttons in one method.

events.name: ItemAdded
events.description: An item is added to the strip.
events.useCase: Style or track items that are created at run time.

events.name: ItemRemoved
events.description: An item is removed from the strip.
events.useCase: Release resources held by the item.

events.name: ItemClicked
events.description: The user clicks an item on the status bar.
events.useCase: Let users click a status label to open details.

events.name: Click
events.useCase: Run the command the button stands for.

events.name: CheckedChanged
events.useCase: Switch a mode on or off, such as Bold.

events.name: Click
events.description: The user clicks the label, which is most useful when IsLink is true.
events.useCase: Open help from a link label on the toolbar.

events.name: TextChanged
events.useCase: Keep the window title in step with the label.

events.name: SelectedIndexChanged
events.useCase: Apply a zoom level or a filter.

events.name: TextChanged
events.description: The text of the box changes.

events.name: DropDown
events.description: The list is about to open.
events.useCase: Refresh the entries just before they are shown.
